scientific_integrity: Proof given for arbitrary fields and every radical dimension n>=1. Exhaustive computations only support the six listed finite cases. Related work in other terminology might exist; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classification is for weight-zero K-linear operators on split unital radical-square-zero algebras of finite radical dimension; finite counts require finite fields. No claims for longer/nonsplit radicals or other weights.
title: Characteristic-two Rota–Baxter resonance on square-zero local algebras
